Google Expands Access to Gemini 4 Carbon AI Model

Google has expanded access to its Gemini 4 Carbon artificial intelligence (AI) model, making it available to developers, businesses, scientists, and consumers. The advanced AI engine is designed for complex tasks including software development, cybersecurity, financial research, and scientific reasoning, supporting multi-agent workflows. This rollout aims to bring advanced AI capabilities to users for tasks requiring multiple steps and extended reasoning.
